arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)
for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {sheet} ({df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} cols) ---")
    print(df.to_string())

import zipfile
import re

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    xml = z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml").decode("utf-8")

# Print any formula elements and the cells that contain them
for m in re.finditer(r'<c r="([A-Z]+\d+)"[^>]*>(.*?)</c>', xml, re.S):
    ref, body = m.group(1), m.group(2)
    f = re.search(r"<f[^>]*>(.*?)</f>", body, re.S)
    v = re.search(r"<v>(.*?)</v>", body, re.S)
    if f or v:
        print(ref, "formula:", f.group(1) if f else None, "value:", v.group(1) if v else None)
